summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 26/26) and frontend (Playwright) testing of NikahKita. Discovered and fixed a critical gating bug on protected pages (ChecklistPage/BudgetPage/GuestListPage/FavoritesPage/VendorDashboardPage/AdminPage) that redirected logged-in users to /signin before auth bootstrap completed. After fix, all tools/admin/vendor flows work end-to-end. Backend 100% green; most frontend flows pass with a few minor data-testid naming mismatches vs. the test plan.

ui_bugs.component: ToolsPages/AccountPages (ChecklistPage, BudgetPage, GuestListPage, FavoritesPage, VendorDashboardPage, AdminPage)
ui_bugs.issue: requireAuth check ran before AppProvider.bootstrapped resolved /auth/me, causing a flash-redirect to /signin on direct navigation or hard reload even when a valid nk_token was in localStorage. FIXED by this testing agent: now waits for `bootstrapped` before deciding to redirect.

integration_issues.issue: The Telepon input has no data-testid (only WhatsApp does: vendor-form-whatsapp). It is `required` on the form, so automated tests cannot submit the create-vendor form via testids alone. Add data-testid="vendor-form-phone" to the Telepon <Input>.
Review plan referenced data-testid="vendor-whatsapp-button" but code uses `vendor-sticky-wa-cta`. Element exists & opens wa.me correctly — just a naming inconsistency vs. plan.
Review plan referenced guest-name-input / guest-add-button; code uses guest-new-name / guest-add. Works correctly, naming inconsistency only.
Review plan referenced approve-vendor-{id}; code uses admin-approve-{id} and admin-pending-{id}. Works correctly, naming inconsistency only.

action_items: (Already applied by testing agent) Keep the bootstrapped-gated redirect fix in ToolsPages.jsx and AccountPages.jsx — add equivalent gating anywhere else that uses `user` for redirect-on-null.
Add data-testid="vendor-form-phone" to the Telepon <Input> in /app/frontend/src/pages/AccountPages.jsx VendorDashboardPage form so vendor profile creation can be fully E2E tested.

(Optional) Align data-testids with the names in the review plan OR update the plan: vendor-sticky-wa-cta → vendor-whatsapp-button; guest-new-name → guest-name-input; guest-add → guest-add-button; admin-approve-{id} → approve-vendor-{id}.
(Optional) Add alias testids `signup-role` or treat the two role buttons (signup-role-couple/signup-role-vendor) as the canonical selectors (they currently work).
critical_code_review_comments: AppProvider exposes `bootstrapped` but previously no protected page respected it. Any new protected route must gate on `bootstrapped` to avoid auth-flash redirects.
api.js and store.js correctly inject Bearer token from localStorage; /auth/me is called once on mount — OK.
server.py excludes _id properly on every GET; good.
server.py uses `require_role` helper but it is never invoked anywhere — admin checks are inlined. Minor dead code.
Vendor filter: `price_min` and `price_max` filters set independent $gte/$lte on different fields — logic is OK but counter-intuitive; works for seed data.
AuthPages SigninPage always navigates to `/` after login — admin / vendor users get sent home then have to click a nav link. Minor UX: consider role-aware redirect.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all primary flows verified end-to-end after bootstrap fix; vendor-create form blocked only by missing data-testid on phone input)

seed_data_creation: No manual seed needed. /api/seed is idempotent and triggered by frontend Shell on mount; also called explicitly from pytest session fixture. 32 vendors (confirmed: GET /api/vendors returns 33 now including TEST vendor created in approve-flow test), 10 real weddings, 7 reviews, 3 demo users seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. The AdminPage shows 0 pending vendors because test runs have been auto-approving them. To exercise the admin approve UI in isolation, sign up a NEW vendor via /signup (click signup-role-vendor first), fill the vendor form in /vendor/dashboard, then log in as admin → /admin to see the pending card with data-testid admin-pending-{id} and admin-approve-{id}. Note the phone field currently has no data-testid, so it must be filled by label/css. The ID↔EN language toggle works (nav-language-toggle-id / nav-language-toggle-en), featured vendor grid renders, hero search navigates to /vendors?category=&city=, directory filter+sort functional.
rca of the issue: RCA (fixed): Protected pages had `useEffect(() => { if (!user) nav('/signin'); ... }, [user, nav])`. On a fresh page load, AppProvider initializes `user=null` and asynchronously fetches /auth/me. The protected-page effect fired immediately with null user and navigated away before /auth/me resolved — so even logged-in users were kicked to /signin on direct URL / reload. Mitigation: AppProvider already exposes `bootstrapped` which flips to true after /auth/me settles; I updated requireAuth and each protected useEffect to short-circuit until `bootstrapped` is true. After this change all /tools/*, /favorites, /vendor/dashboard, /admin routes render correctly for valid tokens.
